high_level_description: This image depicts the exterior of a church building. The focal point is a large golden statue of Jesus Christ, which is mounted on the facade above the entrance. The statue is detailed, showing Jesus with one hand raised, possibly in a gesture of blessing or teaching. The statue is set against a white background with decorative columns flanking it. The church's exterior wall is made of brick, giving it a traditional and sturdy appearance. There are two golden crosses on either side of the statue, adding to the religious symbolism.
